label: Pinterest Ads
terms_note: Pinterest API v5 ads endpoints require app approval and ads scopes; console ToS not read this session

discovery.auth: oauth2 authorization code (https://www.pinterest.com/oauth/ → https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token; scopes ads:read, ads:write) + client-credentials for some flows
sdks: https://github.com/pinterest/api-description (official OpenAPI 3.0.3 bundle, JSON + YAML; Pinterest also publishes generated SDKs — pinterest-python-sdk etc., not opened)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Pinterest REST API v5 ads surface).
auth: 1. Create an app at developers.pinterest.com (Trial access by default).

2. OAuth 2.0 authorization code: `https://www.pinterest.com/oauth/` → `POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token` (Basic auth with app id / secret; `grant_type=authorization_code` / `refresh_token`). Scopes: `ads:read` ("See all of your advertising data"), `ads:write` ("Create, update, or delete
3. Request Standard access ("To ask for a rate limit change, file a ticket with our support team") once the integration is built.

endpoints.notes: `name, status ACTIVE/PAUSED/ARCHIVED, objective_type, daily_spend_cap / lifetime_spend_cap (micro-currency), start_time, end_time, is_flexible_daily_budgets`
`campaign_id, name, status, budget_in_micro_currency, bid_in_micro_currency, bid_strategy_type, budget_type, targeting_spec{}, placement_group, billable_event`
`ad_group_id, pin_id, creative_type, destination_url, name, status, tracking_urls`
`media_type video`, `upload_url, upload_parameters`; pin `board_id, media_source{source_type, url / media_id}, title, link`
`name, rule{}, audience_type; list_type EMAIL / MAID …, records`
`data[]{event_name, action_source, event_time, user_data{em[], hashed}, custom_data{value, currency}}`
`start_date, end_date, granularity DAY, columns[], level CAMPAIGN…, campaign_ids`

reference.limits: - Trial: 1,000 requests/day per app for all endpoints, **ads_write 300/day**, org_write 300/day. Standard: 100 requests/second per user per app; per minute per user per app — ads_read 1,000, ads_write 400, ads_analytics 300, ads_conversions 120,000 (per ad account), advanced_auction_read 50 / write 25, catalogs 100. - Free API; Pinterest Developer Guidelines and Advertising Guidelines apply; Standard access is granted through support review.
mcp_sdk: Official: OpenAPI bundle (github.com/pinterest/api-description, MIT) and Pinterest-generated SDKs (Python `pinterest-python-sdk`, others — not opened). No official MCP server.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token (starts with `pinr`) from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, ads:read and ads:write. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and every refresh returns a new one: the runtime keeps the rotated token in memory, and when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set it saves it to <dir>/pinterest.json (mode 0600) and prefers it over this variable on the next start.

me.note: GET /v5/user_account: the account behind the token (username, account_type, business_name, ...).

list_accounts.note: GET /v5/ad_accounts?page_size=250 (the maximum; list_accounts takes no paging arguments; shared accounts included by default). Paging is by `bookmark`; only the first page is returned.

list_campaigns.note: GET /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns. `status` is sent as entity_statuses (ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, DRAFT, DELETED_DRAFT; default ACTIVE+PAUSED). Budgets (daily_spend_cap, lifetime_spend_cap) are micro-currency integers and start_time/end_time Unix seconds, left in raw. Paging is by `bookmark`; only the first page is returned.

get_report.note: GET /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/analytics?start_date&end_date&campaign_ids&columns&granularity=DAY (dates YYYY-MM-DD, up to 90 days back). campaign_ids is REQUIRED by Pinterest, so pass campaign_id. Returns one object per campaign per day.

update_budget.note: PATCH /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id (config)}/campaigns [{id, daily_spend_cap}]. daily_spend_cap is an integer in MICRO-currency of the advertiser's currency (e.g. 25000000 = 25.00) and applies to campaign-budget-optimization campaigns (ad-group budgets must stay 0/unset). `currency` is ignored. A rejected item (exceptions, no data) is reported as invalid_input.

pause_resume.note: PATCH /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id (config)}/campaigns [{id, status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}]. Returns the updated campaign's status; a rejected item (exceptions, no data) is reported as invalid_input.

config_fields.name: ad_account_id
config_fields.help: Ad account id (digits) that update_budget and pause_resume PATCH (PATCH /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns); those verbs take only a campaign id.

evidence: host api.pinterest.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinterest/api-description/main/v5/openapi.yaml: 6/6 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: POST /v5/oauth/token answered 500 code 12 for a numeric dummy client id and 401 'Authentication failed' for a non-numeric one (checked by hand), so the token endpoint is live; the 500 is Pinterest's handling of an unknown app id. get_report: spec says "response path fields.spend='SPEND_IN_DOLLAR' is not in the response schema"; waived: the analytics rows carry one key per requested `columns` value (SPEND_IN_DOLLAR, IMPRESSION_1, CLICKTHROUGH_1 are sent in columns); the schema lists only CAMPAIGN_ID and DATE get_report: spec says "response path fields.impressions='IMPRESSION_1' is not in the response schema"; waived: the analytics rows carry one key per requested `columns` value (SPEND_IN_DOLLAR, IMPRESSION_1, CLICKTHROUGH_1 are sent in columns); the schema lists only CAMPAIGN_ID and DATE get_report: spec says "response path fields.clicks='CLICKTHROUGH_1' is not in the response schema"; waived: the analytics rows carry one key per requested `columns` value (SPEND_IN_DOLLAR, IMPRESSION_1, CLICKTHROUGH_1 are sent in columns); the schema lists only CAMPAIGN_ID and DATE
